A.positive:
An ornate gothic writing desk sits juxtaposed to its surroundings in the middle of an ancient elven glade, there are fireflies and fairy lights floating around - it's a truly magical scene, midnight, the moon is full and high in the sky, a single cloud passes over head, casting just a bit of shade over the edge of the woods, but enough to obfuscate beyond a few feet. 

The grass is bellowing in the wind, and a book on the desks shelf sits open pages fluttering in the wind

A human skull with vampire fangs sits on the desk with a ink well inlaid in it's crown, it's mouth is open and holds many inkwell styled / quill pens. 

There is a letter in the center of the desk, 
it reads 
" Nothing is true 
             Everything is permitted" 

in fancy gothic inspired font. 

The edges of the words seem to glow an otherwordly glow - as they outline themselves on the parchment paper beneath them. 

The edges of the parchment are lined with occult symbols that seem to shimmer in the candle and moon light - 

Volumetric lighting, cinematic lighting, uhd, 8k, painstaking attention to detail, 
Professional shot, Dynamic angle, Mystical, fantasy,
